messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Art. 5(4)

Article 5 Placing on the market and putting into service. 4. Where machinery is also the subject of other Directives relating to other aspects and providing for the affixing of the CE marking, the marking shall indicate that the machinery also conforms to the provisions of those other Directives. However, where one or more of those Directives allow the manufacturer or his authorised representative to choose, during a transitional period, the system to be applied, the CE marking shall indicate conformity only to the provisions of those Directives applied by the manufacturer or his authorised representative. Particulars of the Directives applied, as published in the Official Journal of the European Union, shall be given on the EC declaration of conformity.

response.text:
machinery | shall indicate conformity to | provisions of other Directives affixing CE marking | machinery is also subject of other Directives relating to other aspects providing for CE marking | the marking shall indicate that the machinery also conforms to the provisions of those other Directives
CE marking | shall indicate conformity only to | provisions of those Directives applied by the manufacturer or his authorised representative | one or more of those Directives allow the manufacturer to choose the system to be applied during a transitional period | the CE marking shall indicate conformity only to the provisions of those Directives applied by the manufacturer or his authorised representative
particulars of Directives applied | shall be given on | EC declaration of conformity | | Particulars of the Directives applied, as published in the Official Journal of the European Union, shall be given on the EC declaration of conformity.
